erin: heads up: deploybot started rolling `quant-embed-kernel-v2.1+abi12` in us-central-1 during the quiet window. Canary shows unexpected driver probe failures and a small increase in 5xx. considering an immediate regional hold.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout initiated for bundle quant-embed-kernel-v2.1+abi12 in us-central-1. Canary slice: 12 hosts. (run `deploybot status 1769995555`)

sre-bot: quick dashboard: error-rate on canary hosts 1.1% vs baseline 0.15%. nvml logs show repeated cuBLAS probe failures then fallback to generic kernel. link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1769995555

marko: paste from host uc1-canary-03:
```
[2026-03-22T01:12:01Z] kernel: cublas_probe: probe failed: ABI_mismatch
[2026-03-22T01:12:02Z] runtime: fallback_kernel generic_gemm selected
[2026-03-22T01:12:03Z] runtime: tail_latency p95=240ms model=quant-embed-kernel-v2.1
```

ops_kai: looks like driver ABI mismatch on a subset of nodes. options: 1) regional pause + pin to v2.0 2) narrow canary and add a probe-fail early abort 3) roll forward with throttle. I prefer pause + pin until we verify shim.

erin: agree. Ops, can you execute regional pause and set pin TTL to 2h? Also file a quick release-note hold.

deploybot: UPDATE: Regional pause recommended (latency+errors). Suggested command: `deploybot rollback --region us-central-1 --bundle quant-embed-kernel-v2.0+abi11 --reason "canary cublas probe failures"`

ops_kai: executing rollback play now, ETA ~5m. also setting pin TTL=2h.

sre-bot: ticket RUNTIME-4127 created: "quant-embed-kernel-v2.1 canary probe failures in us-central-1". Attached nvml traces and canary metrics.

marko: I'll run a local repro with driver 520.x and 525.x to confirm the ABI probe behavior and test a shim that bypasses the probe and asserts cuBLAS availability before switching kernels.

erin: thanks. release-bot, add a brief note to release notes: "HOLD: quant-embed-kernel-v2.1 rollout paused in us-central-1 due to driver probe mismatches. Investigating."

release-bot: NOTE: Release notes updated by erin. Entry ID RN-7219.

ops_kai: rollback complete in us-central-1 at 1769995687. Canary hosts back to quant-embed-kernel-v2.0+abi11.

erin: consensus workflow worked. Follow-ups: marko to validate shim/repro, add driver-gate preflight test, and keep hold in release notes until green. Closing thread; will reopen if repro shows no fix. :thumbsup:
